h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tinsukia

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tinsukia

items.pText: Tea estates around Tinsukia often run their own schools and look after the welfare of families in the garden lines, and a playground is a common request. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for estate schools and colonies, as well as for town schools, oil and railway colonies and parks in Tinsukia. Everything comes from our factory in Vasai East, about 2,460 km away.

Upper Assam is one of the wettest parts of the country, with heavy rain from about April to October and cool winters. Estate sites can be a long way down unpaved roads. The equipment goes by road all the way to Upper Assam, where our own team or a dealer in eastern India installs it. Share photos of the site and of the approach road, and we will plan the delivery along with the layout drawing.

richText.heading: Playgrounds for tea estate schools and lines

c: An estate often wants play areas at more than one place: the school, a creche and one or two open spaces in the lines. Planning them together on one order means one dispatch over a long distance. facts.value: About 2,460 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you supply several play areas on one tea estate?
items.a: Yes. Send us photos and sizes for each site. We plan them together on one order, with a layout drawing for each, so everything is dispatched from Vasai at once.

items.q: Will the equipment survive Upper Assam's rain?
items.a: Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts do not rust. Place each play area on firm, raised ground and grout the posts so soft, wet soil does not loosen them.

items.q: Can a truck reach an estate on an unpaved road?
items.a: Send us photos of the approach road and the nearest point a truck can reach. We plan the delivery and installation around it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
